case"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Ch1 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;43F with Tinea corporis\u003C\/h1\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EThis is an online e blog to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of input from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EThe patient is 43 years old female who is a high school teacher. She used to suffer from frequent high fever, throat pain and loose motion in her childhood. She had broken her left elbow at the age of 8. In 1989,she suffered from jaundice. She was diagnosed with allergic rhinitis at 14 years of age.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EIn the year 2002, for the first time she had severe itching in her neck which resulted in pus. At that time she had done homeopathic treatment. She experiences severe itchiness in her feet whenever she wears rubber sandal since 2016. She has been suffering from itchiness in her elbows, thighs, feet , shoulder and private parts since October 2022. Her itchiness in elbows started with dryness along with flakes and bleeding. She had used Clotrimazole cream in her private parts which relieved her from the itching in July. She had used moisturizer on her elbows. Itching in her feet, thigh and shoulder have stopped after using the prescribed medicines.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EMother-She has COPD.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EFather(late)- He died because of heart failure.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EBrother- He has shoulder injury.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr case"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Ch2 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;75F with COPD and fever\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EThis is an online e blog to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of input from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EThe patient is 75 years old female. She is a retired school teacher and is managing her tea gardens now. In the year 1990 she was detected with cyst in her right breast. She went to doctor with complaints of severe pain and swelling. Biopsy result was good and operation was done. She is suffering from cough and cold every winter since 1992. Though\u0026nbsp; the last two years were not severe. She has high pressure(since 1992) and anxiety. She went to doctor with complaints of severe vomiting, headache, acidity and high pressure.\u0026nbsp; Only one of her doctor(local PHC) said she has bronchitis in the year 2010. Currently she is taking Stamlo 5,Beta 40\/25,Omez D . She had taken antibiotics (clavam 625mg) and cough syrups in her initial years of\u0026nbsp; cough and cold. After that she had taken inhalers such as budecort and duolin in the year 2017 (only when she felt difficulty).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EShe also had brain stroke in 2018(march), her symptoms were high blood pressure and severe headache, she again had brain stroke in 2022.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;In late 2020, she started taking nebulizer. Currently, the patient is suffering from severe breathing difficulty and fever. She is bedridden since 7th January, distressed and is not able to use the washroom without support.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;She has chronic anxiety (worried about family members) and wheezing. She didn't think she would suffer like this which is causing her mental distress and breakdown.\u0026nbsp; She is feeling like a burden which is causing her mental trauma. Her appetite is also less. She is feeling like a burden on her family. She is not able to cope up with the situation that she is so sick. She says she wants to die without any pain with a smile plastered on her face. She is not able to accept that she is 75 as she didn't think she would survive. She is termed as a dominant, headstrong ,independent woman by her family members so when she has to ask for help she isn't feeling good. She couldn't accept the fact that she is becoming weak so she is getting aggressive and irritated. She is getting tensed thinking about her 3 grand-children, what will happen to them if she is no more. Though her family members can see her mentally strong. Moreover few days back(29.1.23) she has lost one of her elder brother whom she loved dearly. She is tensed thinking about her son. Her daughter in law is ignoring her, wouldn't let her daughter meet her. She thinks the disease is communicable. She is getting anxious thinking that a huge war will break out after her death for property between son and daughter.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EShe is a widow with 2 children and 3 grandchildren.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EFather(late)- He had cough and cold. Died because of brain stroke.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EMother(late)- She also had cough and cold. Died because of brain stroke.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003ESisters(2)-\u0026nbsp; one of them had Died because of\u0026nbsp; brain stroke.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003EBrothers(6)- two of them Died because of brain stroke, one of them Died of liver cirrhosis, one suicided\/murdered and one of them Died because of brain stroke and heart failure.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Ch3 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS:(06.1.23)\u003C\/h3\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFever\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECOPD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELow 40\/25\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOmezD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBudecort\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDuolin\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EParacetamol 650mg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Ch3 BETWEEN CAFFEINE, ADENOSINE AND DAYTIME SLEEPINES "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 24px;\"\u003ECONNECTION BETWEEN CAFFEINE, ADENOSINE AND DAYTIME SLEEPINES\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003ECaffeine is CNS stimulant.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003EIt is mainly used recreationally as a cognitive enhancer, increasing alertness and attentional performance.Caffeine acts by blocking binding of adenosine to the adenosine A1 receptor, which enhances release of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003ECaffeine has both positive and negative health effects. It can treat and prevent the premature infant breathing disorders bronchopulmonary dysplasia of prematurity and apnea of prematurity. Caffeine citrate is on the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines.It may confer a modest protective effect against some diseases, including Parkinson's disease. Some people experience sleep disruption or anxiety if they consume caffeine, but others show little disturbance.Caffeine can produce a mild form of drug dependence\u0026nbsp;– associated with withdrawal symptoms such as sleepiness, headache, and irritability\u0026nbsp;– when an individual stops using caffeine after repeated daily intake.Tolerance to the autonomic effects of increased blood pressure and heart rate, and increased urine output, develops with chronic use (i.e., these symptoms become less pronounced or do not occur following consistent use).\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003EOne meta analysis has found that caffeine consumption is associated with a reduced risk of type 2 diabetes.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003EThe DSM-5 also includes other caffeine-induced disorders consisting of caffeine-induced anxiety disorder, caffeine-induced sleep disorder and unspecified caffeine-related disorders. The first two disorders are classified under \"Anxiety Disorder\" and \"Sleep-Wake Disorder\" because they share similar characteristics.\u003C\/span\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 24px;\"\u003EAdenosine \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003Eis a organic compound which occurs widely in nature in form of diverse derivatives. It is crucial for helping one get to sleep,but too much adenosine or any disruption to adenosine system can have a number of negative effects, including daytime sleepiness, addiction, immune imbalances and asthama. It is even hijacked by growing tumors. It's key role is that it controls SLEEP WAKE CYCLE. It is referred as \"MASTER REGULATORS \".\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003EThe accumulation of adenosine in the body is related to the quantity of caffeine consumed during the day. By drinking beverages with high levels of caffeine, the body builds up an excessive amount of adenosine. Often this excess is not fully flushed from the body during sleep. This surplus of adenosine, therefore, contributes to the grogginess many suffer each morning. This feeling encourages people to load up on more caffeine. And on and on it goes! It’s a vicious cycle that results in poorer sleep and feeling tired all day.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003EDue to this reaction, too much caffeine, especially over long periods, can lead to a disrupted sleep cycle. By blocking A1 receptor caffeine promotes wakefulness and by blocking A2A receptor it increases dopamine.\u003C\/span\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003EWhat Is Excessive Daytime Sleepiness?\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003EExcessive daytime sleepiness is defined as difficulty staying awake or alert, or an increased desire to sleep during the day. The feelings of sleepiness may be stronger when you are sedentary, such as while driving or sitting at work. Although it is normal to feel sleepy once in a while after going short on sleep, repeated bouts of drowsiness are considered excessive daytime somnolence when this happens almost every day for at least three months.It is easy to confuse sleepiness with fatigue,since both conditions are characterized by a lack of energy and may arise under similar circumstances, such as being awake for extended periods. The principal difference is that people with fatigue may be unable to fall asleep despite feeling tired and sluggish. It is also possible to experience simultaneous fatigue and sleepiness.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003ESymptoms of daytime sleepiness:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Trouble staying alert\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Feelings of irritation\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Memory problems\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Trouble focusing\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Difficulty retaining new concepts\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Difficulty making decisions\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Slower reaction times\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 20px;\"\u003E• Risk-taking
